Subject: Post-interview stitch: Daniel Vasquez — please drop scores

Team —

Thanks for interviewing Daniel this morning. I want to lock the scorecard and a hiring recommendation by end of day so we can decide whether to move to offer. Please do the following:

- Drop your calibrated scores in the shared scorecard (link below) by 5pm PT. If you have written notes, paste them into the attached notes file.
- If you have a strong hire/no-hire, put a one-line rationale in the "quick verdict" column.
- If you need a tiebreak/deeper calibration, reply here with availability for a 15-min sync tomorrow (Thu).

Attachments: vasquez-tech-scorecard.pdf (scoring sheet stub), vasquez-interview-notes.txt (open notes)
Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Interviews/Vasquez-2026-09-21, HIRE-2813

Quick context: Daniel interviewed for Senior Inference Engineer — solid system design and kernel optimization background, some gaps on production tracing and infra-scale decisions. Candidate was asked both low-level kernel tradeoffs and a past-scale incident.

I did a first-pass: Technical 7, System Design 6, Communication 8, Culture fit 7 — leaning toward hire but flagged the tracing gap. Want broader consensus.

Thanks,
Irene

Irene / team —

Thanks for the notes. I wasn't on the pair-design session but reviewed the recording and Marissa's notes. My scoring: Tech 7, Design 6, Comm 7, Fit 7. Two quick points:

1) The tracing gap is fixable — Daniel has prior OSS contributions to a sampling tracer; with a short ramp plan he'd be productive on day 1 for perf investigations.
2) I flagged the incident response answer as "partial" because he proposed a rollback-first approach without fully considering KV cache warming implications. That's coachable.

I am comfortable with a hire (strong on kernel-level reasoning). If we're unsure, propose we run a 15-min calibration call tomorrow at 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT — otherwise, I'll mark HIRE-2813 as "recommend hire" in the ticket.

Karthik
Staff, Inference Runtime

Thanks all — scores received (Irene, I pulled Marissa's notes and Karthik's quick verdict).

Summary (consolidated):
- Tech: median 6–7
- Design: median 6
- Communication: median 7–8
- Fit: median 7

Current leaning: conditional hire with onboarding plan to address tracing/observability and incident runbooks. No hard red flags.

Action items:
- Irene: please publish a short ramp plan (2–3 bullets) to HIRE-2813 and attach the finalized scorecard (I can take the attachment and tidy the formatting).
- Marissa: can you add the mentoring pairing note (who would be point mentor) into the ticket?
- Karthik: if you agree, please change the HIRE-2813 status to "recommend hire"; otherwise leave it open.
- If anyone is still leaning no-hire, raise it now — otherwise I'll mark consensus and we can proceed to offer draft.

If no objections by 5pm PT, I will schedule a 15-min calibration tomorrow at 10:00 PT (link: https://meet.redwood.com/cal/vasquez-1 ) to finalize the wording for the offer.

Tessa Morgan
